Method of Attack: Empty shell apps designed to lure kids and teenagers wanting to modify Minecraft gameplay
Open browser windows with ads every two minutes
Open Google Play, Facebook, or play YouTube videos to generate ad revenue
Use bots to leave top-star reviews to boost ranking
Apps disappear from phone screen icon but continue showing ads
Impacted Systems: Android devices with Google Play Store
Attack Vector: Publishing fake modpacks on official Google Play Android store
Indicators of Compromise: More than one million installations of fake modpacks
One-star user reviews complaining apps do nothing
Apps causing icon disappearance from phone screen
Aggressive full-screen ads and browser pop-ups
Apps removed from Google Play but still present in other Android markets
